basic_details.job_title: NLUD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Research Associate, Field Researchers Posts
basic_details.job_location: NLUD campus, Sector-14, Dwarka, New Delhi-110078

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified (Online interviews for shortlisted candidates)

qualification.details: Indian or foreign university graduates meeting the academic criteria may apply.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 40,000/- to Rs. 50,000/- per month consolidated

selection_process: Candidates will be shortlisted based on an assessment of their application and submitted materials. Only shortlisted candidates will be interviewed online.
how_to_apply: Visit the official careers portal at careers.nludelhi.ac.in.
Prepare your Résumé/CV including educational qualification, specialization, post qualification experience, and publications as one PDF file.
Combine your undergraduate and/or postgraduate degree copies into one PDF file.
Draft a motivation statement (maximum 500 words) outlining how you fulfill the essential/desirable qualifications and required skills, saved as one PDF file.
Save any other relevant documents not already submitted as one PDF file.
Upload all required PDF attachments and submit the completed form online by 5:00 p.m. IST on 22 October 2026.
important_instructions: The application must be submitted only through the online form; physical or email applications will not be considered. Selected candidates are required to be physically present on the NLUD campus throughout the duration of their appointment. The appointments are for a period of six months with immediate joining. Interviews will be held online, and only selected candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear from the University within 2 weeks after the deadline, assume your application was not selected. The eligibility criteria do not guarantee an interview or final offer. NLUD reserves the right not to fill the positions advertised. If the work or performance of an appointee is found unsatisfactory, their appointment may be terminated by providing one week's notice or one week's salary in lieu of notice.

content_sections.heading: NLUD Research Associate and Field Researchers Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Indian or foreign university graduates meeting the academic criteria may apply.

rows.qualification_required: - Postgraduate Degree in Law (LL.M.) from a recognized Indian or foreign university with a good academic record.- Demonstrated understanding of doctrinal and empirical research methodologies.- Knowledge of substantive and procedural international human rights law.- Proficiency in English.- Skilled in MS Office applications and other research tools.- Prior experience of working in a research project in public international law, international human rights law, criminal law, or fundamental rights is desirable.

- Graduate degree in Law or Social Sciences from a recognised Indian or foreign university, with a good academic record.- Demonstrated understanding of qualitative and empirical research methodologies.- Proficiency in English, including strong written and oral communication skills.- Proficiency in MS Office applications, and other research and documentation tools.- Knowledge of statistics and/or experience with data collection, analysis and documentation is desirable.- Prior experience in field research, stakeholder consultations, or research projects in law, human rights, social sciences or related areas is desirable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at NLUD?
faq.answer: National Law University Delhi is recruiting one Research Associate and two Field Researchers for its project on 'Preparation of India's Common Core Document (CCD) and National Report for the Fifth Cycle of Universal Periodic Review (UPR)'.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies (1 Research Associate and 2 Field Researchers).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 22 October 2026 by 5:00 p.m. IST.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Field Researchers?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate degree in Law or Social Sciences from a recognized Indian or foreign university with a good academic record, proficiency in English, and understanding of qualitative and empirical research methodologies.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these positions?
faq.answer: The Research Associate receives Rs. 50,000/- per month consolidated, and Field Researchers receive Rs. 40,000/- per month consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must complete the online form at careers.nludelhi.ac.in and upload the required PDF documents including CV, degree copies, and a motivation statement.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointments are for a period of six months with immediate joining, and selected candidates must be physically present on the NLUD campus.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an upper age limit specified?
faq.answer: No age limit is specified in the official notification.
